why: Both catch the confound and name the right rerun. Y explicitly ties the 3% hit rate to doubt about whether the cache caused the gain, and it flags the missing pre-agreed decision rule. X gets slightly closer to the noise trap by reporting means (1.8 ms difference rather than the 2.3 ms headline), but it is weaker on mechanism and pre-commitment. Neither notes the run-1-vs-run-1 headline or gives a significance estimate. All numbers in both outputs check out against bench/results.csv.
